key.name: show-gesture-path
key.description: Whether a gesture's path is drawn on screen while it's being drawn.

key.name: window-gap
key.description: Pixels between tiled windows and at the edges of the screen.

key.name: tile-automatically
key.description: Whether every workspace is tiled, also ones added later, without tiling each one.

key.name: tiled-workspaces
key.description: The places of the workspaces that are tiled, counting from 0, so that they're tiled again in the next session.

key.name: closed-sizes
key.description: Apps whose window closed at a size the extension gave it, so they saved that size: for each app, the window's original width and height, the width and height it closed at, and when, in seconds since 1970. The next window the app opens at that size gets its original size back.
